articles.summary: New Houston regional president Eva Pawelek will expand Third Coast's middle-market lending after its Keystone merger, at a bank now holding over $6B in assets.
articles.title: Third Coast Bank Appoints Eva Pawelek as Regional President and Head of Houston Corporate Banking

articles.summary: Holders of record by March 31 will receive the cash payout on April 15, marking the latest quarterly dividend on the bank holding company's Series A shares.
articles.title: Third Coast Bancshares, Inc. Declares Quarterly Cash Dividend on its 6.75% Series A Convertible Non-Cumulative Preferred Stock
